name: AI Agent DevContainer
postStartCommand: bash -c 'bash /workspaces/${localWorkspaceFolderBasename}/dotfiles/install.sh && init-ai-devcontainer-home && (git lfs uninstall || true) && echo OpenCode starting on port ${OPENCODE_PORT:-4096}... && cd /workspaces/${localWorkspaceFolderBasename} && opencode web --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 4096'
